stem:
This is a time line of events in U.S. history.

Rosa Parks's Activism

1943 — Secretary of NAACP in Montgomery, Alabama
1955 — Arrested for violating bus segregation laws
1956 — Arrested for violating anti-boycott laws
1963 — Participated in March on Washington, D.C.
1964 — Part of Freedom Summer voter registration drive

What does this time line imply about Rosa Parks's activism during the Civil Rights era?

options.label: A
options.text: Rosa Parks acted independently from civil rights organizations.

options.label: B
options.text: Rosa Parks continued her activism after the Montgomery bus boycott.

options.label: C
options.text: Rosa Parks completed a large portion of her activism while awaiting trial.

options.label: D
options.text: Rosa Parks learned of civil rights issues following the Montgomery bus boycott.
